title: Strong Shoulders & Back
description: Shoulders and back strength with pike push-ups, diamond push-ups, Superman and scapular push-ups

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the head between the hands

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands close together under the chest, elbows along the body

exercises.name: Archer push-ups
exercises.instructions: One arm extended to the side, lower toward the other hand

exercises.name: Commando push-ups
exercises.instructions: Alternate between plank and push-up position

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: Face down, lift the torso off the floor, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Face down, arms in a Y, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread the shoulder blades without bending the elbows

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
